Implementation complete. The reopen action has been added:

1. **`operations.go`**: Added `reopenOp` with:
   - Name: `"reopen.v5"` (matching the SCHEMA.sql requirement)
   - Role: `"requester"` (only requesters can reopen)
   - Own: `true` (only creator can reopen their purchase)
   - Transition: `"rejected"` → `"submitted"`

2. **`approval.go`**: 
   - Added `single()` wrapper to adapt `protocol.ItemHandler` for single-target operations
   - Registered the `/purchases/{id}/reopen` endpoint using `protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", ...)`
   - Existing `bulk-approve` and `bulk-reject` endpoints remain unchanged

The implementation leverages the existing `protocol.Item` adapter which handles:
- Request body validation (JSON `{"reason":"..."}`, 1-200 bytes)
- Identity authentication and role verification
- Idempotency-Key validation
- Path ID parsing and validation

The Action kernel (`internal/action/action.go`) handles all the transactional logic including:
- Idempotency checking with hash matching
- Concurrent conflict detection via advisory locks
- RLS-protected Purchase updates
- ActionRequest and ApprovalAudit inserts
